record.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Produce ONE isolated WorldSim style05 stone-age game structure, fine controlled warm charcoal-brown ink over restrained quiet low-contrast earth tone wash. Upper-left light: strongly lighter top and left surfaces, darker right/lower surfaces, with no cast-shadow puddle. Outline twice secondary mark width (2:1), broad quiet even low-contrast tone and distinct shadow plane. Use fine gently varied textures, NOT patchy high-contrast watercolor flakes. Wood uses exactly3 broken longitudinal marks per main pole; stone3 facet/crack groups per main rock; clay3 short crack groups; reed5 curved bundle marks per large surface. Shadow hatching one group of3 parallel / marks, never dense all-over hatching. No metal, no dyed cloth. No roof. Whole object centered with generous actual alpha-zero TRANSPARENT margin and cutout gaps. Background must have no nonzero alpha haze; EMPTY transparent space directly adjacent to silhouette. Uprights about16px tall, total44px including overhead footprintdepth. No water painted beneath it, no floor, no fish, no surrounding soil.
